CURRENT SCENE:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P157] 古代的人【很】不知道什么植物能吃
  proposed by the AI checker: 古代的人[-很]不知道什么植物能吃 (很 cannot modify 不知道 here)
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): 在古代[-时候]中国人不知道什么植物可以吃
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 古代的人都不知道[-他]什么能吃
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 古代的生活很多的人吃很多[-的]植物
  rule card fixed_expressions: Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place. Not an error: Do not flag 人山人海 when it describes a scene where many people are gathered in a space.
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

[P158] 也【^】什么植物不能吃
  proposed by the AI checker: 也[+不知道]什么植物不能吃 (parallel clause needs the verb 不知道)
  her past correction (question_patterns): 他们不知道什么植物[-能吃]不能吃
  her past correction (question_patterns): 中国人不知道什么植物[可能还是不可能→能吃，什么植物不能]吃
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): [因为→这样]大家知道什么植物不能吃 — her note: not “because”
  rule card question_patterns: Use 是……吗, V不V, or a Wh-question for an indirect question, not 如果. For “wh-ever…, will do that…”, repeat the Wh-word: 哪一筐……就……哪一筐.
  rule card cause_result_soyi: Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate. Not an error: Do not flag a causal 所以 when the preceding clause genuinely causes the following result. Use 结果 for an unexpected result, and do not use 所以 for sequence (后来), manner (这样), or purpose (为了…).

Not an error: Do not flag a causal 所以 when the preceding clause genuinely causes the following result. Use 结果 for an unexpected result, and do not use 所以 for sequence (后来), manner (这样), or purpose (为了…).

[P160] 所以很多人常常吃【不安全】的植物
  proposed by the AI checker: 所以很多人常常吃[不安全→有毒]的植物 (plants harmful to eat are usually called 有毒的)
  her past correction (specific_noun_choice): 很多的人吃了有毒的[饭→植物]
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 他们吃[毒→有毒的]植物
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 他[看了→看到了]很多人吃毒的植物 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  rule card specific_noun_choice: Use a specific noun or noun phrase when the story needs to say exactly what person, thing, plant, experience, or problem you mean. Avoid general words such as 人、东西、事情、水果, or vague phrases such as 有麻烦. Not an error: Do not flag a general word when the context does not require a more specific meaning. This rule applies when the general word makes the story unclear or does not name what is actually meant.
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.

  rule card resultative_complements: Use a resultative complement when the action reaches its result: 吃到, 写下, 撞到+Obj., or 把Obj. V. Resultative complement. Not an error: Do not use 撞+Obj. when the meaning is that the object hits something else: 撞自行车 means to hit the bike.

[P163] 吃不安全的【植物】对你的身体有坏处
  proposed by the correction model: 吃不安全的[植物→食品]对你的身体有坏处
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 每个人都不知道哪些植物能安全[+地]吃
  her past correction (example_emphasis_connectors): 吃不知名的植物是[特别是危险的→特别危险的] — her note: ”特别是+N, + Clause” is used to single out a typical example
  her past correction (other): 但是[你→他]也吃过有毒的植物
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.
  rule card example_emphasis_connectors: 比方说 introduces a following example; delete it when no example follows. 特别是+N, + Clause singles out a typical example, so N must be an example of the category. Not an error: Do not flag 比方说 when it is followed by an actual example. Do not flag 特别是 when it has the 特别是+N, + Clause pattern and N is a typical example of the category.

[P164] 吃不安全的植物对【你的】身体有坏处
  proposed by the AI checker: 吃不安全的植物对[你的→人的]身体有坏处 (generic statement should not shift to you)
  her past correction (verb_object_valency): 这些植物对身体[+有]好处
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 每个人都不知道哪些植物能安全[+地]吃
  her past correction (possessive_reference): 哪些植物对[-你的]健康有好处
  rule card verb_object_valency: Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself. Not an error: Do not flag 掉 when it is a resultative complement after another main action verb. 掉 can also be used in the structure 掉 + directional + place.
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. [P165] 【^】很麻烦的情况
  proposed by the AI checker: [+这是一个]很麻烦的情况 (the noun phrase needs a subject and verb)
  proposed by the correction model: [+这是]很麻烦的情况

  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.
  rule card specific_noun_choice: Use a specific noun or noun phrase when the story needs to say exactly what person, thing, plant, experience, or problem you mean. Avoid general words such as 人、东西、事情、水果, or vague phrases such as 有麻烦. Not an error: Do not flag a general word when the context does not require a more specific meaning. This rule applies when the general word makes the story unclear or does not name what is actually meant.

[P166] 但是【^】一个人
  proposed by the AI checker: 但是[+有]一个人 (introducing a new person needs 有)
  her past correction (measure_word_choice): 有[一位人→一个人]来了
  her past correction (other_vs_additional): 因为[别的人→有人]正好在他的旁边 — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
  her past correction (adversative_connector): [+但]据人类法律规定
  rule card measure_word_choice: Use the appropriate measure word before the noun: 这/那 + Measure word + noun. Use noun-specific measure words such as 棵 for trees, and 位 is a polite MW. Not an error: Do not use 位 for a child in this context; 位 is a polite MW. 本+N. is usually used in formal advertisement/news and may indicate that the author owns the noun.
  rule card other_vs_additional: 别的 is for a different type or for all others except the one already mentioned. 另外 is for an additional quantity, or for another/the other; say 另外一个人, not 别个人. Not an error: Do not flag 别的 when it means a different type or all others except the one already mentioned.

[P167] 【神农】
  proposed by the AI checker: [神农→叫神农] (the person's name needs an introducing verb)
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: ⟦神农⟧ (first appearance of 神农: briefly introduce who this is)

  her past correction (missing_story_information): ⟦神农吃以后⟧ — her note: miss the result of eating
  her past correction (directional_complements): 神农[起床了→起来了]
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.
  rule card missing_story_information: Do not miss important information in a retelling: include the key scene, action, motivation, or result so the event is complete and clear. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence just because it does not include every possible detail. Flag it only when an important scene, action, motivation, or result is missing and the retelling is incomplete.
